panels.title: HRV · last qualifying
panels.description: Last qualifying five-minute PPG RMSSD from the past 24 hours, shown with its original measurement age. This is not a live reading or whole-night HRV. Requires 98–102% pulse coverage, continuous history, artifact and adjacent-pair checks. The live readiness metric still expires after 15 minutes. Not ECG-validated.

panels.title: Strain · Life
panels.description: Life cardio strain, not WHOOP strain: Edwards load from recorded heart rate and your configured maximum, mapped logarithmically to 0–21. See coverage; missing time contributes no load. Set maximum HR in Life. No age-based defaults. See docs/SCORING.md.

defaults.noValue: Set max HR in Life; record 10 min

panels.title: Sleep · duration score
panels.description: Self-reported sleep duration minus awake time / your configured sleep target, capped at 100%. This is a duration score, not inferred sleep quality or sleep stages. Log sleep in Life. Latest completed session expires after 36 hours.

defaults.noValue: Log sleep and set target in Life

panels.title: Stored history delay
panels.description: Age of the latest indexed WHOOP history record. Live HR can remain current while stored history is delayed. HRV, breathing, temperature and overnight summaries depend on this history.

panels.title: Analysis queue
panels.description: HRV and breathing windows awaiting calculation or recalculation. Existing downloaded data is processed before the analyzer returns to its idle interval.

panels.title: Stored records · 24h
panels.description: Fraction of the past 24 hours covered by consecutive, nonconflicting history records. Missing time and sequence gaps are excluded. This is data availability, not sensor accuracy.

panels.title: HRV · qualified coverage 24h
panels.description: Union of qualifying five-minute HRV windows over the past 24 hours. Overlapping windows count their covered time once. This is availability, not a medical confidence score.

panels.title: Breathing · qualified coverage 24h
panels.description: Union of qualifying estimated-breathing segments over the past 24 hours. A zero means no segment passed the existing signal rules, not zero breaths.

panels.title: HRV · continuity-limited windows
panels.description: Number of analyzed windows in the past 24 hours failing the adjacent-pair requirement. Includes other possible failures. Empty batches can be legitimate at low HR or withheld by the device; no intervals are joined across them.

panels.title: Breathing · last estimate
panels.description: Last qualifying pulse-derived breathing estimate from the past 24 hours, with its original measurement age. Requires at least 90 contiguous seconds, 98–102% pulse coverage, artifact checks and consistent spectral/autocorrelation estimates. No computed device breathing-rate field has been identified. More recording time alone does not guarantee a qualifying signal. Not reference-validated.

panels.title: SpO₂
panels.description: Device-calculated SpO2 from Harvard 41.17.4.0 history byte 86. Zero and firmware error codes are not percentages. 98 is withheld because the firmware can also return 98 for missing optical DC. Latest usable reading within 24 hours; see measurement age. Accuracy has not been checked with an independent sensor.

targets.expr: whoop_spo2_percent and on(device) (whoop_spo2_ready == 1) and on(device) (time() - whoop_spo2_observed_timestamp_seconds <= 86400)

panels.title: Signal quality
panels.description: Signal checks are engineering screens, not a medical confidence score. A successful screen does not establish accuracy.

panels.title: Oxygen age
panels.description: Device-calculated SpO2 from Harvard 41.17.4.0 history byte 86. Zero and firmware error codes are not percentages. 98 is withheld because the firmware can also return 98 for missing optical DC. Latest usable reading within 24 hours; see measurement age. Accuracy has not been checked with an independent sensor.

panels.title: Strain · recorded day
panels.description: Fraction of elapsed local day covered by consecutive valid HR records. Missing intervals are excluded.

panels.title: Cardio load · Edwards
panels.description: Life cardio strain, not WHOOP strain: Edwards load from recorded heart rate and your configured maximum, mapped logarithmically to 0–21. See coverage; missing time contributes no load. Set maximum HR in Life. No age-based defaults. See docs/SCORING.md.

panels.title: Sleep · logged duration
panels.description: Self-reported sleep duration minus awake time / your configured sleep target, capped at 100%. This is a duration score, not inferred sleep quality or sleep stages. Log sleep in Life. Latest completed session expires after 36 hours.

panels.title: Sleep · measurement age
panels.description: Time since the most recent completed, self-reported sleep session. Results expire after 36 hours.

panels.title: Battery · verified
panels.description: Only cross-checked readings less than ten minutes old are displayed. No data means unknown, not zero battery.

panels.title: Last strap traffic
panels.description: Age of phone-observed strap traffic. Delayed uploads do not make old readings fresh.

panels.title: Backend queue
panels.description: Backend outgoing samples. The iPhone's separate queue appears in the Life app.

panels.title: Export review
panels.description: Rejected or older-than-window samples and timestamp conflicts stay archived; they are never retimestamped.

panels.title: Heart rate
panels.description: Original observation timestamps. Live points use phone receipt time. Graphs are visualization, not inputs for HRV calculations.

panels.title: Battery history
panels.description: Only matching standard/custom readings are exported. Gaps are kept visible.

options.content:
**Life · WHOOP**

Stored history sync is enabled for validated transfer layouts. HRV uses firmware-decoded pulse intervals and conservative five-minute quality checks. Physiological accuracy has not been compared with ECG. Sleep duration is self-reported; strain is an independent Life cardio-load score. Prometheus alert rules are installed; external notifications are not configured.

panels.title: Wrist skin temperature
panels.description: WHOOP 4 skin sensor, decoded from Harvard 41.17.4.0 firmware. Signed word at frame offset 76 / 10 °C. Sensor error values and readings older than ten minutes are hidden. No user calibration. Measures skin, not core body temperature. A fixed offset does not convert one into the other.

panels.title: Skin temperature history
panels.description: Original history-record time. Gaps mean missing or invalid sensor readings. Firmware decoder versions remain separate.

panels.title: Temperature sensor diagnostics
panels.description: Raw words from v24 history, shown without unit conversion. Offset 76 is now identified as skin temperature in tenths °C for the supported firmware; other channels retain raw labels.

panels.title: HRV · last qualifying
panels.description: Last qualifying five-minute PPG RMSSD from the past 24 hours, shown with its original measurement age. This is not a live reading or whole-night HRV. Requires 98–102% pulse coverage, continuous history, artifact and adjacent-pair checks. The live readiness metric still expires after 15 minutes. Not ECG-validated.

panels.title: HRV · latest pulse coverage
panels.description: Pulse interval duration / 300 seconds for the latest analyzed window. Acceptance requires 98–102%. This is not a medical confidence score.

panels.title: HRV · measurement age
panels.description: Age of the qualifying five-minute measurement window.

panels.title: HRV history · five-minute RMSSD
panels.description: PPG-derived RMSSD over five minutes, rounded to whole milliseconds for display. At least 98% pulse duration coverage, no history gaps, artifact and adjacent-pair checks. Latest qualifying window expires after 15 minutes. Not ECG-validated. Scrape time is analysis observation time; the measurement window end is shown separately.

targets.expr: whoop_hrv_rmssd_ms and on(device) (whoop_hrv_ready == 1) and on(device) (time() - whoop_hrv_window_end_timestamp_seconds <= 900)

panels.title: Breathing history · estimated
panels.description: Estimated respiratory modulation of pulse intervals, not a device-reported breathing rate. At least 90 contiguous seconds, coverage and artifact checks, spectral/autocorrelation agreement and stable frequency. Accuracy has not been validated against a respiratory reference. Hidden after 15 minutes. Analysis scrape time is distinct from measurement time.

panels.title: Oxygen history · device calculation
panels.description: Device-calculated SpO2 from Harvard 41.17.4.0 history byte 86. Zero and firmware error codes are not percentages. 98 is withheld because the firmware can also return 98 for missing optical DC. Latest usable reading within 24 hours; see measurement age. Accuracy has not been checked with an independent sensor.

targets.expr: whoop_spo2_percent and on(device) (whoop_spo2_ready == 1) and on(device) (time() - whoop_spo2_observed_timestamp_seconds <= 86400)

panels.title: Breathing · contiguous signal duration
panels.description: Longest segment when none reach 90 seconds; otherwise the latest candidate segment. Passing duration alone is insufficient.

panels.title: Breathing · measurement age
panels.description: Last qualifying pulse-derived breathing estimate from the past 24 hours, with its original measurement age. Requires at least 90 contiguous seconds, 98–102% pulse coverage, artifact checks and consistent spectral/autocorrelation estimates. No computed device breathing-rate field has been identified. More recording time alone does not guarantee a qualifying signal. Not reference-validated.

panels.title: Oxygen · device status
panels.description: Raw diagnostic result code. 0 means no computed value. 98 is ambiguous and never published as saturation. Other flags stay unavailable. See docs/RESPIRATION-OXYGEN.md.

panels.title: Sleeping heart rate
panels.description: Median HR during your logged sleep interval, requires 80% recorded coverage and 30 minutes.

panels.title: Sleeping HRV
panels.description: Median qualifying five-minute RMSSD windows inside logged sleep. At least three windows and 50% union coverage.

panels.title: Sleeping wrist temperature
panels.description: Median firmware-decoded wrist temperature during logged sleep, requires 80% recorded coverage.

panels.title: Wrist temperature · baseline change
panels.description: Difference from the median of at least seven prior nights within 28 days. At most one sleep of at least three hours per date.

panels.title: Strain history · recorded load
panels.description: Life cardio strain, not WHOOP strain: Edwards load from recorded heart rate and your configured maximum, mapped logarithmically to 0–21. See coverage; missing time contributes no load. Set maximum HR in Life. No age-based defaults. See docs/SCORING.md. Each point is the accumulated daily load at analysis time. Late backfill updates the current total without rewriting previous scrapes.

panels.title: Sleep history · reported duration
panels.description: Self-reported sleep duration minus awake time / your configured sleep target, capped at 100%. This is a duration score, not inferred sleep quality or sleep stages. Log sleep in Life. Latest completed session expires after 36 hours.
